description: This file defines a PHP class JobTitleSearchFilterParams which extends a FilterParams class, representing search filter parameters for job titles in the HRM system. It includes allowed sorting fields and a property to filter only active job titles.

classes.name: JobTitleSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Represents filter parameters for searching job titles, including allowed sort fields and an 'active only' filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets default sort field to 'jt.jobTitleName'.

methods.name: getActiveOnly
methods.description: Returns whether only active job titles should be included.

methods.name: setActiveOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only active job titles if true, or all if null or false.
